description.narrative: Stöd genom Trócaire till ett MR-konsortium för stöd i olika former till MR-försvarare och offer för MR-överträdelser; för monitorering och rapportering av MR-överträdelser; för stöd till och kapacitetsutveckling av rättighetsbärare och organisationer. Särskilt fokus på kvinnor och ungdomar.

Support through Trócaire to a human rights consortium för support in different forms to human rights defenders and victims of human rights abuse; for monitoring and reporting of human rights abuse; for support to and capacity building of rights holders and organisations. Special focus on women and youth.

Trócaire is working together with a Consortium of local civil society partners. The project has three intermediary outcomes: 1. Duty bearers are challenged by organised citizens to respect and protect human rights. 2. Reduced barriers to gender equality in civil and political rights. 3. Equipped civil society organisations sustain their role of supporting citizens and communities to exercise their rights.

Examples of results from the Annual Report 2024:
* Legal support was provided in 343 cases, benefitting 2375 persons, with an 81% success rate on concluded cases.
* Medical support was provided to 556 people (333 males, 223 females), and 585 persons (308 males, 277 females) received psycho-social support.
* The project documented 1,123 incidents of Human Rights Violations, affecting 29,931 individuals.
* Civic education, community dialogues, and advocacy training empowered 19,928 individuals, leading to 6,806 people engaging in 112 advocacy actions.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
